concept.title: Daytime Running Light (DRL)
concept.shortdesc: The DRL can make it easier for others to see the front of your vehicle during the day.

conbody.p: Daytime running lights (DRL) help other drivers see the front of your vehicle during the day, especially after dawn and before sunset.
Use the Daytime running lights (DRL) whenever you drive during daylight.
The system turns on the Daytime running lights (DRL) when the headlamp switch is in the OFF or AUTO position (when daylight is detected) and the Electronic parking brake (EPB) is released.
The Daytime running lights (DRL) will turn its DRL lamp off when:

li.p: The vehicle is in OFF position.
When the parking brake is engaged while vehicle is in ON position.
The system automatically turns on the headlamps at night when the headlamp switch is in the AUTO position.
When the front fog lamps are on

conbody.p: You can turn off the daytime running lights by engaging the brakes with the headlights on and turning off the headlights.
